title: What the most-downloaded mods need from the bridge, most-used first
text: python bench/convert_coverage.py real reads the jars of the 150 most-downloaded NeoForge mods for 1.21.1 and lists every NeoForge class and member they use that the bridge lacks, in the order that clears the most mods soonest. 442 hold 82 mods back, and the list has a short head: the next 20 take the count from 68 to 94. Each one is added from NeoForge's own published files (.claude/skills/convert-a-mod), checked without a mod by python bench/bridge_check.py in about a minute and a half, and counted again by the same command. The list predicts the compiler on the corpus: all 15 mods it shows with nothing missing compiled after converting.
finish: 100 of the 150 most-downloaded NeoForge mods for 1.21.1 use nothing the bridge lacks (68 today), and the corpus count rises with it (15 of 28 today)
wrongIf: the count of clear mods rises by 20 and no more corpus mods compile and load
